Carmen (SE): HelioBank sent an SQ asking for RBAC change audit evidence, KMS rotation proofs, and vuln triage notes. They need an auditor-ready export before tomorrow's review call.
Alice (InfoSec): Okay — export should include role-change events, actor IDs, rotation events, and a signed manifest. Also a README explaining redaction and retention.
Ben (SRE): We have an export script: /scripts/export_audit.sh --tenant=heliobank --since=365d --types=auth,roles,kms --out=/tmp/helio-audit.tar.gz. Will verify role-change + svc-account ops are present.
sec-bot: export job queued: job-id=jb-20260322-01 tenant=heliobank
sec-bot: job started by Ben (SRE) at 2026-03-22T10:05:12Z
Carmen (SE): Helio also wants KMS rotation lineage and proof of envelope wrapping; for their on-prem pilot they asked for HSM provenance.
Jake (Infra): For managed KMS we can include kms.rotation.* events and key metadata (key-id, created_at, rotated_at). HSM audits are separate — Ops needs to pull those. Ops ETA: 2026-03-23T08:30Z.
Priya (Solutions): We'll include a README in the bundle that lists generation command, manifest checksums, signer (redwood-audit-key), and redaction policy. Good for auditors.
Alice (InfoSec): Also draft a short attestation email template from security@redwood referencing the signed manifest checksum and chain-of-custody contact.
Ben (SRE): Export completed: job-id=jb-20260322-01 out=/secure/exports/helio-audit-20260322.tar.gz checksum=sha256:3f7a9b0c5d... signed-by=redwood-audit-key. Permissions: internal/sec.
Carmen (SE): I'll send the initial bundle to Helio and note HSM artifacts will follow within 48h if needed during the call.
Alice (InfoSec): For CVE-2025-9999: summary only — patched 2025-06-10 (v2.4.1), config hardening, verification via regression tests. Include timeline, patch ver, and verification steps in call materials.
Priya (Solutions): Action items: Ben — deliver bundle + README now; Jake — confirm HSM export upload; Alice — draft attestation.
Jake (Infra): Will update when HSM export is uploaded.
Carmen (SE): Thanks team — I'll add the artifacts to the call packet and follow up if Ops HSM logs arrive.
